message.body:
Hi,

Thanks for coming back to me. I'm afraid June and July 2027 are already fully booked for Jake, but he does still have two Saturdays free in November 2027: Saturday 6 November 2027, Saturday 20 November 2027. Alternatives: Saturday 11 September 2027, Saturday 16 October 2027. £300/£250x4 (2x1hr) or £350/£300x4 (3 sets), own PA, no deposit, 7.30pm fine.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
